quote: Following a temporary acceptance by Bolivia's National Road Administration Bureau, the El Sillar Highway Project, the largest ongoing road construction project in Bolivia, recently fully opened to traffic. It was built by POWERCHINA. … The El Sillar Highway Project winds its way through the Andes Mountains, serving as a crucial part of National Route 4, which connects Cochabamba and Santa Cruz, two major Bolivian cities. The highway spans a total length of 30.3 kilometers, with the road surface 20.6 meters wide. The highway features four separate tunnels, 17 bridges, 6.1 kilometers of reinforced concrete retaining walls, 21,000 meters of anti-slide piles, and 139 culverts.
note: Opened POWERCHINA English 28 Nov 2023 (El Sillar 30.3 km opening).
